cd /app/tmp/work && rm -f perf/*.req perf/*.out perf/tmp.prog && du -sh perf && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10,"packet_limit":5,"prefix_width":2,
     "rules":[{"id":7,"class":2,"priority":10,"ranges":[[100,105],[-60,-60]]}],
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); open(path,"wb").write(p.stdout)
# odd whitespace / CRLF / no trailing newline
data = b'  {"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0}\r\n{"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":1,"length":102},{"flow":1,"time":2,"source":0,"length":60}]}\r\n{"op":"close","flow":1,"time":2}'
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print("rc",p.returncode)
for l in p.stdout.splitlines(): print(" ",l.decode())
print("stderr",p.stderr[:200])
# empty stdin
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=b"",stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("empty rc",p.returncode,"out",p.stdout)
# compile with trailing newline / spaces in config
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=b"  "+json.dumps(cfg).encode()+b"\n\n",stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("compile ws rc",p.returncode,len(p.stdout))
# compile with BOM -> invalid
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=b"\xef\xbb\xbf"+json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("compile bom rc",p.returncode,p.stdout)
EOF
